import os, stat
tot=0; n=0
for base,dirs,files in os.walk('src'):
    for name in sorted(dirs+files):
        p=os.path.join(base,name); st=os.lstat(p); n+=1
        assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode), p
        assert st.st_nlink==1, (p, st.st_nlink)
        if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            raw=open(p,'rb').read(); raw.decode('utf-8'); tot+=len(raw)
print('entries(excl root):', n, 'bytes:', tot, 'limits: 128 /', 4*1024*1024)
